"""Rate lookups. Every lookup is billed, so callers must not repeat them needlessly."""

LOOKUPS = 0
_RATES = {'grand': 4, 'plaza': 4, 'harbour': 3, 'lodge': 3}


def rate_for(hotel):
    """Return the rate for a hotel. Each call is billed and counted in LOOKUPS."""
    global LOOKUPS
    LOOKUPS += 1
    return _RATES[hotel]

import rates
from bookings import load_bookings, ROWS
from charges import BookingBill


def test_charge_after_add():
    rows = list(load_bookings())
    bill = BookingBill()
    bill.add(rows[0])
    first = bill.charge()
    bill.add(rows[1])
    assert bill.charge() == first + ROWS[1][1] * rates._RATES[ROWS[1][0]]


def test_no_new_lookups_when_unchanged():
    bill = BookingBill()
    for x in load_bookings():
        bill.add(x)
    bill.charge()
    before = rates.LOOKUPS
    bill.charge()
    bill.charge()
    assert rates.LOOKUPS == before
